candidates.title: ILS data integration
candidates.statement: The system shall obtain reporting data from the enterprise-level Library Automation System (ILS), including the Acquisitions and Cataloging modules.
candidates.source_quote: Management Processes rely on the data structures and functionality of an enterprise-level Library Automation System, including Acquisitions and Cataloging modules.

candidates.title: Vendor website and file interfaces
candidates.statement: The system shall interface with vendor websites via published APIs and/or automated transfer of standard-format data files (e.g., USMARC21, EDIFACT) to ingest external data for reporting.
candidates.source_quote: Management Processes interface with a variety of vendor websites, via published APIs and/or automated transfer of standard-format data files (e.g., USMARC21, EDIFACT).
candidates.priority_signals: Some libraries use external vendors for certain functions. Our reporting needs to handle data from these sources too.

candidates.title: OPAC patron data queries
candidates.statement: The system shall query the Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC) to obtain patron data (including holds and circulation) for use in reports.
candidates.source_quote: Patron data (holds, circulation) is created in the OPAC. Our reports need to query this data.

candidates.title: Documented reports functionality for Evergreen
candidates.statement: The system shall provide optimal Reports functionality that can be documented and included in a future Evergreen release, as defined by a consolidated Reports requirements list.
candidates.source_quote: Document optimal Reports functionality within a future Evergreen release and develop a list of requirements.
candidates.priority_signals: All members agreed the mission is still accurate and relevant.

candidates.title: Reports testing workflow
candidates.statement: The system shall support a Reports testing workflow/process through which all new Reports development is filtered.
candidates.source_quote: Become the Reports testing group, through which all new Reports development would be filtered.
candidates.priority_signals: All members agreed the mission is still accurate and relevant.

candidates.title: Executive Reports Interface
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an Executive Reports Interface that includes the compiled list of reports needed for executive use.
candidates.source_quote: Compile a list of reports needed for an Executive Reports Interface.
candidates.priority_signals: All members agreed the mission is still accurate and relevant.

candidates.title: PINES report templates
candidates.statement: The system shall provide the ability to determine, create and deliver report templates needed for all PINES libraries.
candidates.source_quote: Determine and create templates needed for all PINES libraries.
candidates.priority_signals: All members agreed the mission is still accurate and relevant.
